title: Monday Morning Breakfast Diaries
caption:
monday morning breakfast diaries 
chilli oil fried eggs & iced mocha coffee

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 48 | F: 19 | P: 24
Calories: 474 per serve
Serves 1

Ingredients
2 eggs
1 tsp chilli oil
1/2 tsp sesame seeds
1 sprig spring onion greens
salt + pepper, to taste
2 slices brown bread

150 ml chilled, lactose free milk
1 sachet mocha coffee from @colombianbrewcoffee
